PartsPage.title: Parts
PartsPage.weight_note: Weight prefers the measured range across community-recorded mold batches; with no batch record it shows the weight a source publishes for the Part. Parts with neither show a dash.
PartsPage.catalog_stats_note: Computed from the Blade, Ratchet, and Bit; this is not a separately published product stat block.
PartsPage.catalog_stats_unavailable: Some component data is missing, so these stats cannot be computed yet.
PartsPage.catalog_search_placeholder: Search by official name, alias, or abbreviation
PartsPage.catalog_composition_unknown: The source does not record which Parts this Beyblade is built from.

MetaStandingPage.title: Meta standings
MetaStandingPage.intro: This site doesn't publish subjective tier rankings — these standings come entirely from real event result statistics.
MetaStandingPage.no_tier_list_note: No S/A/B-style tier labels — every number carries its own sample size and statistical period so you can judge its reliability yourself.
MetaStandingPage.empty_state_body: {count} event appearances are recorded so far — not enough to compute any Combo's performance yet. Once event result data accumulates, this page will show each Combo's usage rate, top-8 rate, and champion count.

MoldBatchPage.title: Mold batch lookup
MoldBatchPage.intro: Enter the batch code printed on a part or its packaging to see recorded production notes. This page only covers batches that have been documented with a source.
MoldBatchPage.noMatches: No recorded batch matches that code.
MoldBatchPage.instructionsBody: The code is usually printed in a small area on the packaging or the part itself. Enter the letters and numbers as printed. Batch differences are community observations, not official Stat Editions.
MoldBatchPage.sourceGuidanceScope: This is general research guidance, not a Part-specific batch or weight observation.

WhereToBuyPage.title: Where to buy {partName}
WhereToBuyPage.intro: These are the latest Stock Listings captured from retailers. Prices and availability change; the retailer page is the source of truth for a purchase.
WhereToBuyPage.databaseUnavailable: The Stock Listing database is not connected yet. This does not mean the part is unavailable; this page simply has no live snapshot to show.
WhereToBuyPage.emptyBody: No retailer snapshot is available for this part yet. When a scrape succeeds, its price, availability, and capture time will appear here.
WhereToBuyPage.disclaimer: OldBabyInfo does not handle transactions. The retailer is responsible for the purchase, price, and availability after you leave this page.

DiscussionPage.title: Latest discussion
DiscussionPage.intro: Discussion lives beside the Part, Combo, or Event it explains. Use this page to follow the latest useful observations back to their data.
DiscussionPage.emptyBody: New posts will stay attached to the data they explain and appear here.

AuthPage.title: Sign in to OldBabyInfo
AuthPage.privacy: Only the basic identity needed to show a discussion author is used. OldBabyInfo does not create a password for you.
AuthPage.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured yet. The maintainer must provide the Auth.js secret and either Google or LINE OAuth credentials as environment variables.

TermsPage.title: Terms and disclaimer
TermsPage.lede: OldBabyInfo is a player-maintained reference tool. It is not an official site and does not represent any brand, retailer, or event organizer.
TermsPage.communityBody: Discussion posts are the observations and opinions of their authors, not statements by OldBabyInfo. Do not post personal data, harassment, hate, or infringing material. We may hide content that breaks these rules.
TermsPage.dataBody: Part, event, and batch data includes a source or collection note where available. Data may be incomplete or wrong, so confirm important decisions against the original source.
TermsPage.purchaseBody: OldBabyInfo does not handle transactions, collect payment, or guarantee price, availability, quality, or delivery. After you leave for a retailer, the purchase is between you and that retailer.
TermsPage.reportBody: Report errors, infringement, or harmful content through the project maintenance channel. We will review reports according to the available evidence.
